questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph A) One of the crocodiles was four feet long and almost six years old. B) Post this announcement a video of a crocodile attacking a dog has gone viral causing people to panic further. C) The authorities have announced that more crocodiles would be sighted once the waters recede. D) After the monsoon deluge the Forest Department of Vadodara has so far rescued three crocodiles which had swum into residential areas.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph
A) One of the crocodiles was four feet long and almost six years old.
B) Post this announcement a video of a crocodile attacking a dog has gone viral causing people to panic further.
C) The authorities have announced that more crocodiles would be sighted once the waters recede.
D) After the monsoon deluge the Forest Department of Vadodara has so far rescued three crocodiles which had swum into residential areas.
questions.solution:
C) DACB
• Sentence D: "After the monsoon deluge the Forest Department of Vadodara has so far rescued three crocodiles which had swum into residential areas."
This sentence sets the context of the paragraph, introducing the situation of crocodiles being rescued after a monsoon.
• Sentence A: "One of the crocodiles was four feet long and almost six years old."
This sentence provides additional information about one of the rescued crocodiles, making it a logical follow-up to Sentence D.
• Sentence C: "The authorities have announced that more crocodiles would be sighted once the waters recede."
After discussing the rescued crocodiles, this sentence introduces the prediction made by authorities about more crocodile sightings in the future.
• Sentence B: "Post this announcement a video of a crocodile attacking a dog has gone viral causing people to panic further."
Finally, this sentence connects to the previous one by showing a consequence of the authorities' announcement - the viral video and resulting panic among people.
When arranged in the order DACB, the paragraph flows coherently and presents a clear narrative.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A) Next, step by step from the shallow waters you are gradually guided to dive in safe areas. B) This ‘dry’ lesson is followed by wearing the gear and then entering shallow waters to practice basic scuba diving skills. C) The Discover Scuba Diving tour starts with a 30 minute lesson on teaching basic skills outside water. D) Finally, what is most reassuring about the whole tour is that your instructor is always by your side to monitor you ill the end of the session.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A) Next, step by step from the shallow waters you are gradually guided to dive in safe areas.
B) This ‘dry’ lesson is followed by wearing the gear and then entering shallow waters to practice basic scuba diving skills.
C) The Discover Scuba Diving tour starts with a 30 minute lesson on teaching basic skills outside water.
D) Finally, what is most reassuring about the whole tour is that your instructor is always by your side to monitor you ill the end of the session.
questions.solution:
D) CBAD
The correct answer is D. CBAD. Here is the explanation for the arrangement:
C. The Discover Scuba Diving tour starts with a 30-minute lesson on teaching basic skills outside water.
• This sentence introduces the Discover Scuba Diving tour and describes the first step of the process: a lesson outside the water.
B. This ‘dry’ lesson is followed by wearing the gear and then entering shallow waters to practice basic scuba diving skills.
• This sentence logically follows the first one, describing the next step after the initial "dry" lesson, which is wearing gear and practicing in shallow waters.
A. Next, step by step from the shallow waters, you are gradually guided to dive in safe areas.
• This sentence details the progression from shallow waters to diving in safe areas, building on the previous step mentioned in sentence B.
D. Finally, what is most reassuring about the whole tour is that your instructor is always by your side to monitor you until the end of the session.
• This sentence serves as a concluding statement, emphasizing the presence of an instructor throughout the experience for safety and reassurance.
